quotes.text: A native macOS standard-fullscreen window began 39 pixels below display top; this is outside web content. Add Window → Fill Entire Display (`Control-Command-Shift-F`) using Electron simple fullscreen. It stays on the current desktop, while standard fullscreen uses a separate macOS Space. [Task 4]
